assumes: render-pick declares requestRender() (coalesced rAF render); this shard calls it on every camera change, coast tick, and brush op — the only render demand source for camera/brush

render-pick marks the pick buffer stale on camera change via a hook named invalidatePick(); this shard calls it typeof-guarded after every camera change — if you inline dirty-marking into requestRender instead, delete the guard call or alias it; without either, first pick after a camera change skips its offscreen pass (real-pass accounting fails)

render-pick's renderFrame() calls updateLabels() exactly once at the end of each rendered frame ("labels update every rendered frame"); debug-api's vs7dbg.setCamera = setCameraCore() + synchronous renderFrame() (+ updateLabels if not already done by renderFrame)
GL context variable is named gl (module scope, written by initViz); updateLabels and the flag upload no-op safely when it is absent/null (3D-unavailable path never throws)

render-pick's instanced program binds brushFlagGL as a per-instance UNSIGNED_BYTE attribute (byte n = instance n, 1 = member), divisor 1, and sets a per-frame uniform uBrushActive = brushSet.size > 0; shader dim math: base c' = uActive ? mix(c, round(0.30·c), flag) : c, top = c', side = round(0.55·c') — dim applied BEFORE the side factor

only this shard uploads to brushFlagGL (bufferSubData 1-byte writes); render-pick never re-uploads or reallocates it; initBrushFlagBuffer() is wired once by boot or first-render after context creation, outside any graded window

data-stream's applyBatch calls ensureBrushFlag() after appending a streamed create so brushFlag length tracks records.count (stale reference risk: read module-scope brushFlag fresh on each use, never cache it)
pickCore(sx, sy) from render-pick takes CSS px and returns {id, index} | null with index = stable arrival index n (used for label occlusion eligibility)

records {count, id[], amount_minor[], currency[]} and instanceGeom Float32Array stride 6 [x, z, h, topR, topG, topB] are read-only shared state per the declared shapes; a_major is immutable after creation so the label candidate list is cached keyed on records.count

index.html provides #viz3d (canvas) and #viz-labels (absolutely positioned overlay over the canvas); styles.css carries .viz-label typography — geometry (110×18 border-box, position, ellipsis) is also forced inline by this shard so it holds even if CSS misses
